name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-08-12.22.1) introduced by West Australian Senator [Dorinda Cox](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/dorinda_cox) (Greens), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add ", but the Senate calls on the Government to ensure that any decision that may be made by the CEO of the National Disability Insurance Agency, or their delegate, under the bill must:* > > *(a) be approved by a second decision maker within the Agency;* > > *(b) be subject to both internal and external appeal; and* > > *(c) provide transparency around the considerations, reasons and outcomes of the decision".*
